features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light
features.text: You have superior vision in dim light and darkness. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Acid Resistance
features.text: You have resistance to acid damage.

features.name: Night Life

effects.note: You have advantage on Charisma checks and Charisma saving throws at night or in dim light. If you are a 13th-level necromancer, you gain the ability to cast the vampiric bite spell on yourself, without a spell slot and without material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you must finish a long rest before you can cast it on yourself again.

features.name: Bite

effects.note: You can make a bite attack that is a natural melee weapon. On a hit, you deal 1d6 piercing damage plus your Strength modifier. You can't use this attack if you already used your tail on the same turn.
